sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This fixture owns the executor, invokes shutdownNow unconditionally in finally and requires actual termination within ten seconds before the owned registry closes. The generic AutoCloseable method introduces an unbounded wait.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: The site operates on fixture-owned unit test workers with maximum ten-second invokeAll and bounded termination. No application or service thread is spawned.

sourceAnchors.message: Use equals() to compare object references.
sourceAnchors.reason: The oracle requires the exact published immutable snapshot object to be one of the two submitted references. Value equality would permit a different instance and would not prove this design condition.
